battle.name: 英土戰爭 (1807年-1809年)
battle.theater: 東地中海埃及與黎凡特海岸
battle.brief: 英土戰爭是1807至1809年英國與鄂圖曼帝國之間的戰爭。英軍以燧發槍方陣攻入埃及與敘利亞海岸，1808年4月8日在阿卡擊潰奧斯曼與馬穆魯克聯軍，卻因離岸太遠、補給不繼而於同年夏秋退回地中海。

kit.name: 燧發槍
kit.history: 擊錘打火比火繩穩。線性列陣的射速和精度都靠它撐著。

countries: 英方為大不列顛及愛爾蘭聯合王國，骨幹是皇家海軍地中海分隊，以戰列艦「Canopus」與「Endymion」為主力，另分出小隊巡弋馬爾馬拉海、埃及沿岸與愛琴海；陸戰由海軍陸戰隊與數個國民步兵營組成，火炮為國王騎炮兵的火箭連與皇家炮兵野戰連。指揮系統由海軍大臣與陸軍參謀總部直下地中海總指揮海軍少將杜克思，再分交各支隊指揮官。奧斯曼方面由樞密院運作，蘇丹塞利姆三世在位，軍政分掌於大維齊爾穆斯塔法·巴伊拉克達爾與海軍統帥；駐埃及總督穆罕默德·阿里以阿爾巴尼裔步兵與阿拉伯非正規軍為骨幹，敘利亞防線則由阿卡的卡夏索萊曼·賈扎爾與數千馬穆魯克騎兵協同防守。俄國同期在多瑙河下游用兵，使鄂圖曼無法得到法國的實質援助，英方也因此只需面對一個分心的敵手。
countriesEn: The British side was the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland. Its core was the Royal Navy's Mediterranean station, built around battleships such as Canopus and Endymion, with detached squadrons cruising the Sea of Marmara, the Egyptian coast and the Aegean. On land the expedition was composed of Royal Marines and several line infantry regiments, with a rocket troop of the Royal Horse Artillery and field batteries of the Royal Artillery providing the guns. The chain of command ran from the Admiralty and the War Office down to the commander in the Mediterranean, Vice-Admiral Sir John Duckworth, and from him to the commanders of the individual detachments. The Ottoman side was run by the Sublime Porte under Sultan Selim III, with military and naval authority divided between the Grand Vizier Mustafa Bayrakdar and the Kapudan Pasha who headed the fleet. Ottoman Egypt was held by Governor Muhammad Ali, whose backbone was a corps of Albanian soldiers supplemented by Arab irregulars, while the Syrian line was defended from Acre by the Kayha Sulaiman Jazzar together with several thousand Mamluk horsemen. Because Russia was fighting on the same theatre, the Porte received no meaningful military assistance from France, and Britain faced an opponent already stretched thin.
people: 英方的主導人物是海軍少將約翰·托馬斯·杜克思，他於1807年2月強行進入達達尼爾海峽、3月初被迫退出，1808年又二度駛入海峽向鄂圖曼當局施壓。陸戰的關鍵人物是准將約翰·阿伯克羅姆比，他率英軍縱隊在1808年4月8日於阿卡外與奧斯曼大軍正面交鋒，攻毀其攻城砲隊，隨即奉令回撤。海軍方面有上校愛德華·科德靈頓參與攻擊馬爾馬拉海的鄂圖曼分遣隊與沿岸封鎖。奧斯曼一邊，蘇丹塞利姆三世在1806年9月拒絕英國四項最後通牒，成為把外交危機變成戰爭的關鍵決定；大維齊爾穆斯塔法·巴伊拉克達爾主持海峽與敘利亞的防務；埃及總督穆罕默德·阿里在英軍佔領期內收復開羅、整編軍隊，使自己的權位在戰後急升；馬穆魯克首領艾哈邁德·阿加·邁斯里在阿卡潰敗後倒向英方，削弱了鄂圖曼在埃及的支柱。法國方面則由駐君士坦丁堡大使塞巴斯蒂亞尼促使蘇丹靠向拿破崙，種下戰爭的遠因。
peopleEn: The central figure on the British side was Vice-Admiral John Thomas Duckworth, who forced the Dardanelles in February 1807, was driven back out in early March, and returned to the straits with his fleet in 1808 to put pressure on the Porte. The decisive soldier was Brigadier-General John Abercromby, who led the British column into the Battle of Acre on 8 April 1808, broke up the Ottoman siege train there, and then had to withdraw on orders from London. At sea, Captain Edward Codrington took part both in the destruction of the Ottoman detachment in the Sea of Marmara and in the blockade of the coast. On the Ottoman side the crucial decision was Sultan Selim III's rejection of the four-point British ultimatum of September 1806, which turned a diplomatic crisis into a shooting war. Grand Vizier Mustafa Bayrakdar organised the defences of the Straits and of Syria; the governor of Egypt, Muhammad Ali, retook Cairo while the British were in occupation and reorganised his army, so that his own position rose steeply after the war; and the Mamluk notable Ahmad Agha al-Masri deserted to the British after the rout at Acre, weakening a pillar of Ottoman Egypt. France's part was played by the ambassador in Constantinople, Count Sebastiani, whose diplomacy had first drawn the Porte towards Napoleon and so planted the deeper cause of the war.
kits: 卡面這件燧發槍是英軍步兵的制式火器：槍管口徑約十四公厘，槍口裝刺彈，以定裝紙包火藥供彈，單兵齊射可達每分鐘數發，線性列陣的射速與精度全靠它撐住。1807年自馬耳他啟程的遠征軍登船時，手中槍械多為舊式「Brown Bess」一系，其後陸續換裝1802年諾克型，火繩槍已退到埃及與阿拉伯盟軍手中。英軍火炮為六磅與九磅野戰砲，另配少量野戰榴彈砲，國王騎炮兵的康格里夫火箭連在1808年埃及與阿卡戰役中投入野戰，是火箭早期實戰的重要記錄之一。奧斯曼步兵仍混用燧發與火繩長槍，另有十二磅與十八磅滑膛砲；埃及馬穆魯克騎兵配燧發手槍、彎刀與短身火槍，尼羅河上則靠三角帆的達哈比耶河艇巡邏。全役的火藥與口糧都靠海運，馬耳他到亞歷山大約一千五百公里，遠征軍離本土太遠，也正是日後撤退的根源。
kitsEn: The flintlock musket shown on the card was the standard arm of British infantry: a barrel of roughly fourteen millimetres, a bayonet fixed at the muzzle, prepared paper cartridge charges to carry the powder, and a rate of fire of several rounds a minute for each man in the line. The troops who embarked for the Mediterranean in 1807 still carried a good number of the older Brown Bess pattern, with the 1802 Nock pattern gradually replacing them; the matchlock had by then been pushed down to the Egyptian and Arab allied troops. British artillery consisted of six- and nine-pounder field guns with a few field howitzers, and the rocket troop of the Royal Horse Artillery put Congreve rockets into the field during the Egyptian and Acre operations of 1808, one of the earliest recorded battlefield uses of the weapon. Ottoman infantry still mixed flintlock and matchlock long guns, backed by twelve- and eighteen-pounder smoothbore guns. The Egyptian Mamluk cavalry carried flintlock pistols, scimitars and short carbines, while on the Nile the river was patrolled by dahabeah boats under lateen sails. Every round of powder and every ration came by sea, and the run from Malta to Alexandria is some fifteen hundred kilometres; the armies were simply too far from home, which was the root of the later withdrawal.
tactics: 海峽之戰是典型的強行突入加封鎖：英艦隊在1807年2月19日駛入達達尼爾海峽，先在馬爾馬拉海摧毀鄂圖曼分遣隊，再以縱隊封住海峽入口；奧斯曼在法國工程人員協助下趕築岸炮，英軍反被岸炮轟擊而失去兩艘軍艦，遂於3月3日退回地中海。陸戰方面，英軍以海軍作移動基地，先在亞歷山大港建立補給點，再沿海陸路向阿卡推進；內陸行軍缺乏縱深補給，一次失誤即引發退兵。1808年4月8日阿卡之戰，英軍以步兵縱隊與輕炮排成攻擊線，選定攻城砲隊所在方向一次打穿，砲火與火箭同時壓向密集的鄂圖曼陣地；鄂圖曼以非正規軍密集縱隊反覆衝鋒，馬穆魯克騎兵多次發起衝鋒，均被線性射擊與刺刀頂回。撤退時英軍以縱隊行軍，殿後部隊逐段遲滯追兵，最後自海路撤出。海上的封鎖則靠攔截商船、監視港口，再以小艇施壓，正是後人所說的「炮艇外交」雛形。
tacticsEn: The Dardanelles action was a textbook forced passage followed by a blockade. On 19 February 1807 Duckworth's squadron drove into the straits, first destroying the Ottoman detachment in the Sea of Marmara and then forming in column to seal the mouth of the straits. The Ottomans, helped by French engineers, threw up shore batteries in time, and the British ships were counter-battered until two were lost, so the squadron fell back into the Mediterranean on 3 March. On land the British treated the fleet as a moving supply base: they made a depot at Alexandria and then pushed along the coast towards Acre, but any advance inland was made without depth of supply, so a single miscalculation brought the column back to the sea. At the Battle of Acre on 8 April 1808 the British drew the infantry into attack lines with light guns, picked the line on which the siege train stood, and broke through it in one push while cannon and rockets pounded the crowded Ottoman formations. The Ottomans answered with dense columns of irregulars and repeated charges by the Mamluk horsemen, all of which were thrown back by linear fire and the bayonet. On the way out the column marched in order, its rearguard fighting delaying actions against the pursuit, and the force finally re-embarked for the Mediterranean. At sea the interception of merchant shipping and the blockade of the ports, with small craft pressing close inshore, were the first clear shape of what would later be called gunboat diplomacy.
data: 可考的數字並不多，且多出自英方與鄂圖曼雙方的官方彙報。1806年9月英國提出四項要求，蘇丹全部拒絕。1807年2月19日杜克思進入海峽，3月3日撤出，英軍在此役損失兩艘軍艦。1807年3月16日約六千名英軍自馬耳他啟程赴亞歷山大港，8月佔領埃及大部，至年底因缺糧而於1808年初撤出。1808年再入埃及的英軍在阿卡之戰兵力約五千至六千，面對二萬五千至三萬名鄂圖曼、埃及與阿拉伯援軍，外加數千馬穆魯克騎兵；英軍傷亡約二百餘人，鄂圖曼方面折損以千計，全部攻城砲與輜重淪陷。1808年7月英軍分艦隊炮擊亞歷山大港，8月接佔特內多斯、萊姆諾斯等愛琴海島嶼，9月23日再襲敘利亞海岸。阿卡至亞歷山大約四百五十公里，馬耳他至亞歷山大約一千五百公里。1809年1月5日《達達尼爾斯條約》在英軍艦上簽訂，戰事至此收束。阿卡之外的具體傷亡數字各家記載分歧，諸說並存，此處從略。
dataEn: Few precise figures survive, and most of them come from the official returns of the two sides. In September 1806 Britain put four demands to the Porte and Selim rejected all of them. Duckworth entered the straits on 19 February 1807 and withdrew on 3 March, losing two ships in the action. Some six thousand British troops sailed from Malta for Alexandria on 16 March 1807, occupied most of Egypt by August, and were driven out in early 1808 for want of food. The force that returned to Egypt in 1808 numbered roughly five to six thousand men at the Battle of Acre, against twenty-five to thirty thousand Ottoman, Egyptian and Arab troops reinforced by several thousand Mamluk horsemen. British casualties were about two hundred killed and wounded, the Ottoman side lost thousands, and the whole siege train with its baggage fell into British hands. In July 1808 a British squadron bombarded Alexandria; in August the British took Tenedos, Lemnos and other Aegean islands; on 23 September they raided the Syrian coast. Acre lies some four hundred and fifty kilometres from Alexandria, and Malta some fifteen hundred. The Treaty of the Dardanelles was signed aboard a British ship on 5 January 1809, which closed the war. Figures for casualties away from Acre are variously given and should be treated with caution.
cause: 戰爭源於拿破崙要把鄂圖曼帝國拉到自己一邊。1806年，法國駐君士坦丁堡大使塞巴斯蒂亞尼說服蘇丹取消俄國在1805年取得的黑海通商等特權，並對法國戰艦單獨開放達達尼爾海峽；作為交換，拿破崙許諾協助鎮壓塞爾維亞起義、收復失地。俄軍進兵摩爾多瓦與瓦拉幾亞後，鄂圖曼於同年對俄宣戰。英國擔心法國取得鄂圖曼艦隊、威脅通往印度的地中海商路，於同年9月向塞利姆三世提出四項要求：驅逐塞巴斯蒂亞尼、對法宣戰、割讓多瑙河兩公國，並把鄂圖曼艦隊與海峽要塞交予皇家海軍。蘇丹拒絕後，英國改以封鎖與武裝干預施壓，1807年1月英艦「Leander」在亞歷山大港外與鄂圖曼船隊互射，雙方關係自此無法修復，達達尼爾海峽之役隨即開打。
causeEn: The war grew out of Napoleon's determination to pull the Ottoman Empire onto his side. In 1806 the French ambassador in Constantinople, Count Sebastiani, talked the Sultan into cancelling the privileges Russia had won in 1805, including Black Sea access for its merchants, and into opening the Dardanelles exclusively to French warships; in exchange Napoleon promised help in crushing the Serbian rising and in recovering lost territory. When Russian troops entered Moldavia and Wallachia, the Porte declared war on Russia in the same year. Britain, alarmed at the prospect of a French-aligned Ottoman fleet and of the Mediterranean trade route to India, put four demands to Selim III in September 1806: expel Sebastiani, declare war on France, cede the Danubian Principalities, and hand over the Ottoman fleet and the forts of the straits to the Royal Navy. The Sultan refused, and the pressure turned into blockade and armed interference. In January 1807 the British frigate Leander exchanged fire with an Ottoman convoy off Alexandria, after which relations could not be repaired, and the Dardanelles operation followed.
impact: 這場戰爭沒有分出勝負，卻改變了東地中海的權力格局。鄂圖曼帝國守住了埃及與敘利亞的主要港口，英軍只取得一次會戰勝利，卻因離岸太遠、補給線過長而無法把戰果變成佔領；英國在戰後保住了通往印度的航路並取得鄂圖曼政府的善意，為日後英土結盟埋下伏筆。穆罕默德·阿里藉英軍佔領期與阿卡之戰的機會整編埃及軍隊、削弱馬穆魯克勢力，其後更在1811年大舉消滅馬穆魯克團體，埃及的實際獨立自此起步，十九世紀的東方問題也由這裡發端。塞利姆三世的新軍改革則因戰敗與朝爭而破產，1808年馬哈穆德二世以政變推翻其兄，鄂圖曼的改革自此轉向另一條路。另一面，法國終究沒有得到鄂圖曼艦隊，拿破崙在東方的棋局落空，皇家海軍則藉此確立地中海的絕對控制，亦被後世視為「炮艇外交」最早的實例之一。
impactEn: The war settled no decisive outcome, yet it rearranged the balance of power in the eastern Mediterranean. The Ottomans kept the principal ports of Egypt and Syria; the British won one hard-fought action but could not turn the victory into occupation, because their armies were too far from home and their supply line was too long. What they did carry away was a safer route to India and the goodwill of the Porte, the seedbed of the Anglo-Ottoman alliance of the later 1830s. Muhammad Ali used the British occupation and the confusion of the Acre campaign to reorganise the Egyptian army and to break the Mamluks, and his destruction of the Mamluk corps in 1811 turned that into de facto Egyptian independence, from which the Eastern Question of the nineteenth century grew. Selim III's reforming new army was discredited by the war and by the struggle at court, and Mahmud II overthrew his brother in 1808, sending Ottoman reform down a different road. On the other side, France was denied the Ottoman fleet and Napoleon's eastern design failed, while the Royal Navy used the campaign to make its mastery of the Mediterranean unchallenged; contemporaries later pointed to this war as one of the earliest examples of gunboat diplomacy.
result: 結果可說是模糊而帶有英方小勝的結局。1808年4月8日阿卡之戰是全役最激烈的會戰，英軍以線性射擊與野戰砲摧毀攻城砲隊，奧斯曼與馬穆魯克聯軍在攻勢中崩潰；但英軍當局不願深入內陸而遭切斷補給，隨即下令全軍撤回海岸，同年秋天更陸續放棄愛琴海所占島嶼。鄂圖曼帝國雖未失去埃及，卻在開羅與尼羅河下游付出慘重代價，穆罕默德·阿里的勢力反因戰爭而坐大。1809年1月5日，英方與鄂圖曼當局在英軍旗艦上簽訂《達達尼爾斯條約》，英軍撤出所占島嶼與據點，鄂圖曼恢復對海峽的控制，戰爭以英軍有條件撤退、帝國保住主要屬地的姿態收場。各家史書對此役的定性分歧，或稱英方小勝，或視為鄂圖曼的勝利或一場僵局。
resultEn: The outcome was ambiguous, with a limited British success inside it. The Battle of Acre on 8 April 1808 was the fiercest engagement of the campaign: linear fire and field guns broke the Ottoman and Mamluk army in its assault and destroyed the siege train, but the British authorities, unwilling to advance far inland and risk being cut off, ordered the whole force back to the coast, and through the autumn they gave up the islands they held in the Aegean. The Ottoman Empire kept Egypt, but it paid heavily in Cairo and the lower Nile, and Muhammad Ali's position grew stronger precisely because of the war. On 5 January 1809 the British and the Ottoman authorities signed the Treaty of the Dardanelles aboard a British flagship: the British withdrew from the islands and posts they held, the Ottomans recovered control of the straits, and the war ended with the British in a conditional withdrawal and the Empire still holding its main provinces. Historiography divides over the verdict, some calling it a small British victory, others an Ottoman success or a draw.
